- 高频交易比拼的是微秒级差距，哪怕 50ms 的延迟，都足以影响对百万美金的对冲策略。
https://t.co/dExwMmC1CH

为了尽可能贴合这种需求，不少公链都试图通过提速 / 并行化账本等方式提高交易吞吐。而 @FogoChain 却提出一个反直觉却又合乎逻辑的架构设计：

「区块确认不需要全球节点同时参与，而是轮流站台，共识中心跟着太阳移动。」

➣ 项目概述

- Fogo 是一个基于 SVM（Solana Virtual Machine）构建的高性能 L1 公链，Devnet 数据已达 57,000 TPS、40ms 区块时间。

- 运行 Jump Trading 的 Firedancer 客户端，目标是打造链上毫秒级撮合体验。

- 总融资达 $13.5M，投资人包括 Distributed Global、CMS Holdings、The Block CEO @lawmaster 、Synthetix 创始人 @kaiynne 、 Echo 创始人 @cobie 等一线 OG 。

- 联合创始人 @0xdoug 是技术派代表，同时也是 @ambient_finance DEX 的创始人，擅长流动性机制与执行优化。

- 联合创始人 @RobertSagurton 则为机构金融背景，提出「速度即优势」理念，主导多地共识架构设计。

➣ 核心架构与原理

Fogo 的技术架构可总结为三大部分：

🔸多地共识（Multi-local Consensus）

- 设有三个核心共识中心：纽约、伦敦、东京。

- 每日按时区轮换进行 8 小时共识，模拟跟随太阳的金融交易节奏。

- 本地执行、低延迟撮合，故障时自动切换至全球共识模式。

- 这一模型本质是对「全球同步共识」物理延迟上限（光速）的一种规避。类似高频交易中的「CoLo」（共址架构），将撮合、LP、预言机、验证器等全部部署在同一物理区域。（这便是对我所引用贴文问题的一种解法）

🔸Firedancer 客户端

- 基于 Solana 的高性能并行执行架构。

- Jump Trading 团队研发，专为极限吞吐与最低延迟优化。

- 在 Fogo 中用于构建「类 CEX 执行体验」的核心执行引擎。

🔸许可验证器集合（Permissioned Validators）

- 采用半开放节点接入机制，筛选出高性能验证器运行共识

- 适合对区块生成质量要求极高的交易系统，牺牲「绝对去中心化」换取性能可控性。

一个你从来没听说过的生态，正在酝酿下一个百倍项目——Telegram表情包NFT

6月3日， $TON 生态NFT交易量首次成为全网第一，超越了ETH单日交易量3.5M。

生态龙头NFT，Plush PEPE三个月上涨700%，目前地板价3500TON（约10000U）。

Telegram内部围绕表情包NFT的打新、赠送、社区建设正在如火如荼的展开。

按照成长曲线来看我觉得现在还在早期，信息差和认知差还有。现在开始了解其实也不晚，特别表情包打新的初始金额可能就几百颗星星（几U），也有人说这是ton的铭文时刻。 

不管是未来已来，还是再次复刻ton链三傻的一波流，总是先信赚后信的钱，不如跟我一起潜进去吧。废话不多说，直接上干货。

资产类：

1⃣表情包NFT 龙一Plush PEPE

地位相当于NFT时期的BAYC吧。有钱又想参与生态的，这其实是最好的选择，因为龙一跌了生态肯定也崩，而且表情包NFT生态其实挺乱的，不在社区里面钻研一个星期肯定玩不明白，Plush PEPE就属于大户优选了。
不过10000U的地板价绝不便宜了，而且还是在TON链上。DYOR

2⃣匿名电话
telegram官方推出的匿名账号，每个NFT就是一个匿名账号，买了之后你就可以拥有一个不需要绑定私人手机号的tg账号，懂得都懂。这也是我ton链最看好的一个NFT，一年前我就专门写过一篇thread，当时地板价是100TON，U本位大概涨了7-8倍吧。（购买的时候要注意别买带感叹号的，那是已经被官方封了的账号，买了用不了。）
现在价格非常贵，整个collection估值都4亿美金了。自己判断。

3⃣ Tonnel
最早这个项目在做TON链的龙卷风。TON+龙卷风懂得都懂，去年转型做了Tonnel gift market，当前是telegram上最大的表情NFT交易市场，可能是因为炒币的小伙伴们还没开始注意到这个冷门市场，目前估值相当便宜。

优质博主篇：

1⃣@rich_adul 不用过多介绍，所有冷门生态都能看到他，太努力了，似乎他也非常看好ton nft生态，最近高强度输出内容，且新手友好。

2⃣@NF6X60 专精ton生态，说实话我都不想share出来，我就想这哥们一直无人问津，所有alpha都被我一个人偷了。

3⃣@the_daily_ton 专注ton生态的信息分享。

4⃣@cutepandaweb3 我最早了解到Telegram 表情包NFT，就是通过他，可能也是中文区最早聊plush pepe的博主。

关注这几个再加一下他们的社群，其实就差不多了，当然上一轮我见过最degen的玩法，就是混俄语区社群，@tuotuotuoyu 就是这方面的高手。 AI

text:
Thanks to @proofoftalk for an incredibly well-organized crypto conference — stunning location, curated attendees, strong panels.

Key takeaways 🧵

1. MMs who self-promote usually have to. The best ones don’t.

2. Crypto still romanticized. Many stay for the culture, ideas, identity.

3. Widespread (healthy) skepticism: we might be in a bubble and approaching the top. Yet, blockchain = best tech; decentralization = best philosophy.

4. Side hustles abound — many people quietly bored, investing outside crypto or taking advisory positions.

5. Former startups are going more corporate to be organised. The vibe is shifting quickly. P

6. Both retail and industry remains extraction-heavy. We need real value creators,  not extractors.

7. Many people aren’t speaking honestly about where the space is, only 1 to 1 not to upset close partners.

8. Tokenomics models = worthless without real data. Adoption adjusted vesting is new meta.

9. No PMF? No revenue? Better not to launch a token just to appease VCs. Many serious founders building for IPO exit.

10. US folks aren’t so keen flying to Europe anymore, unless it's pretty location and good weather. NYC is the crypto capital.

11. Sales talent is often surprisingly poor. Most fake TradFi/CeFi/DeFi fluency.

12. Visionaries exist — the accomplished  builders and successful founders thinking legacy, not exits. They’re driving real progress and will continue to do so regardless of the market.

Lot to reflect on. AI

#Token2049 Takeaway 
很多人没来是对的，本10条读完，你也跑了这次大会：

1. AI和Blockchain结合的项目越来越多了，随便一个Founder pitch的时候就是1M user起 - 关键是用户哪来的？

2. 蹦迪的活动越来越多，DJ的品味已经代表了Founder和Marketing Team的品味，进一步上升的话可以成为项目排名（虽然我一个都没去过）

3. 越来越多的人开始讨论健康，永生，和如何保持生命的能量。

4. Tradfi 跑步进场了。

5. 项目方做Marketing的预算普遍收紧了。

6. 中文区KOL的地位越来越高了。

7. 上币的项目市值一个比一个低，行业去泡沫化后反而更友好了。

8. 大多数人最常见的关键词：迷茫、懵懂、不确定性。

9. 会场里面多了很多完全不懂Crypto的人，Mass Adoption的枪声打响了。

10. 越来越多人开始使用Bybit了。 AI

💧 $SOPH nedir?

Sophon, ZK Stack altyapısıyla geliştirilen, sosyal etkileşim, eğlence ve yapay zekayı blockchain üzerinde bir araya getiren bir Layer-2 ağ.
Amaç; kullanıcıların yalnızca tüketici değil, aynı zamanda aktif üretici ve kazanan bireyler haline geldiği oyunlaştırılmış bir dijital katman oluşturmak.

• Tüm işlemleri neredeyse sıfır maliyetle gerçekleştirebiliyor
• Google/Apple hesabıyla saniyeler içinde giriş yapabiliyor

- ZK Validium teknolojisiyle Ethereum güvenliği + zincir dışı veri saklama
- Geliştiriciler için açık SDK: Oyunlar ve dApp’ler kolayca entegre edilebiliyor
- AI + Blockchain altyapısını birleştiren öncü sistemlerden biri

💧 Yatırımcılar

Binance Labs, OKX Blockdream Ventures, Spartan, Paper, Maven11, Karatage gibi önemli fonlardan destek aldı.

💧 Vizyon 

Web2’nin kullanım kolaylığı + Web3’ün dijital mülkiyet gücü.
Özellikle genç kitleye hitap eden, katılımcı ve kazandıran bir dijital sosyal ekonomi modeli.

text:
Ethereum is for shipping.

Here’s 21 things the global @ethereum ecosystem got done in the last few weeks:

1. The latest upgrade to Ethereum, Pectra, went live.

Pectra introduced smart account wallet features to improve UX, increased capacity for Ethereum L2s by 2x, and activated validator UX improvements. 

Ethereum is for 0 downtime upgrades. 

2. @Stripe announced their stablecoin financial accounts. Now Stripe users in 101 countries can use Ethereum to hold, send, and receive stablecoins like USDC. Ethereum is for global financial freedom.

3. @Uniswap crossed $3T in all-time swap volume. Ethereum is for 24/7 decentralized markets. 

4. @Coalapay deployed > $40,000 raised on Ethereum for the victims of the Myanmar earthquake, using the power of stablecoins to get funds directly to aid recipients. Ethereum is for helping those in need.

5. @Superstatefunds announced Opening Bell, enabling companies to issue public equity onto Ethereum. Ethereum is for public markets. 

6. @NasdaqBTCS announced plans to bring ETH exposure into public markets. Ethereum is for ETH.

7. @CoWSwap hit a new record of 24K unique traders, helping protect all of them from the hidden costs of MEV. Ethereum is for the average user.

8. @Aave announced their work with the ANT group to build a real world asset (RWA) marketplace on Ethereum. Ethereum is for tokenization.

9. @ETHRNSM launched a marketing collective for Ethereum, where anyone can submit content that pushes Ethereum culture forward and get rewarded based on performance. Ethereum is for internet culture.

10. @Coinbasewallet announced that @Farcaster will be integrated directly into the wallet feed (early beta), which will enable millions of people to easily use decentralized social media built on Ethereum. Ethereum is for building better social media.

11. @Focustree_app hit 1M downloads & 100K MAUs on @Starknet, helping students earn rewards for staying focused on their studies. Ethereum is for onboarding.

12. @MorphoLabs on @Base reached $1B TVL, The first DeFi protocol to cross this mark on the Base rollup. Ethereum is for DeFi.

13. @World_chain_ now has over 12.5M verified humans on their Ethereum L2. Ethereum is for humans.

14. @ZKsync is now fully EVM equivalent, meaning devs can deploy existing Solidity contracts easily and use existing EVM tooling. Ethereum is for developers.

15. @aztecnetwork launched their public testnet, the next step towards a fully private L2 built on Ethereum. Ethereum is for privacy.

16. Wonder L2 went live, built on @zksync by @WonderFiLabs, which was recently acquired by @RobinhoodApp. Ethereum is for L2s.

17. @SuccinctLabs and @RiscZero announced tech that can prove Ethereum blocks in under 12s, a 10x improvement since last year. This major advancement will accelerate Ethereum’s roadmap and scaling efforts to fully leverage ZK cryptography. Ethereum is for pushing the frontier forward.

Oh, and a few more things…

18. @Base reached stage 1…

19. and @Kinto_xyz reached stage 1…

20. and @Scroll_ZKP reached stage 1…

21. and @Starknet reached stage 1!

Ethereum’s L2 ecosystem is now stronger and more secure than ever before, thanks to the hard work of all these teams. Ethereum is for secure, decentralized L2s that grow the Ethereum ecosystem. AI

text:
Ethereum was my entry into crypto in 2016. I fell in love with the vision for permissionless finance and smart contracts. 

ETH was my first meaningful source of wealth

In 2017 Ethereum was the center of crypto. Up 100x in a year. ICOs. Future of finance. Gas fees spiking. People were using the chain!

ETH was the fastest asset in human history to $100b in market cap. In history!!!

Ethereum was king of the world

Ethereum just had one glaring problem: scaling

I attended Devcon 3. November 2017. Cancun, Mexico. Ethereum was 2.5 years old at the time.

I showed up to Vitalik’s keynote an hour early. I think I was the first person in the room. I was absolutely giddy. Multicoin was 6 weeks old. I was a kid in a candy shop.

The presentation didn’t even attempt to address scaling.

I left the presentation in dismay. I just could not fathom how the EF could be so utterly clueless. How can you not recognize what’s going on around you, and set forth a credible plan with concrete and aggressive timelines? It’s your annual developer conference. This is explicitly *the* venue for sharing the plan!!! $100b in market cap depends on it!!! How can you not even try to address the elephant in the room?

Not a single person in the EF inner circles had the awareness to push for a concrete scaling plan. 

Devcon 3 is when I lost faith in Ethereum

I don’t think much has changed in the 7 years since then. There is still a total lack of urgency, leadership is not in touch with the needs of its core constituents, and there is still no North Star AI

我讲一个白痴的问题（白痴的市场信息差）：
关于Sonic生态的空投

Sonic公链的第一季空投会在6月18号结束，总量2亿空投，然后其中有一部分会空投给官方发行的Sonic shark NFT持有者。

我是一个天生的乐观派

一个NFT的持有者如果拿到5%的空投，那就是540枚；
如果拿到10%的空投，那就是1081枚。
（更详细的比例见下方图片）

目前Sonic shark的地板价是150S，S的价格是0.39美金（逼近年底最低了），一个NFT的价格也只有50u的成本。

只考虑币本位，这一笔空投的收益是360%，如果S今年下半年的价格高于0.39，那这笔交易的收益只会更多。

关于这笔交易，有几个说明事项：
1、成本问题，这一套NFT其实来自于去年Sonic官方的The road to Sonic，成本其实非常高，单号至少需要花费50u，目前二级市场抛售的人他们几乎等于是在平价出售

2、Sonic的空投会以25%立刻释放，75%在270天内线性释放的方式完成，所以这将是一笔币本位的投资。我选择买入的理由是，我相信Sonic生态会在下半年彻底反弹。

3、官方对于这套NFT的表达实在过于暧昧，过于名牌。if you know,you know。

我再讲一个白痴的问题：
年初很多人批量去买DerpNFT，因为有很多人在预测会有空投，结果一年到头的空投除了最开始的shadow，可能只有10u不到。

一个不确定性的空投，你们买到4000S

一个确定性的空投，你们在150S的时候眼睁睁看着机会错过？

别做白痴。

【HyperBEAM 推出 Milestone 3 Beta 1：引入可信执行环境，迈向去中心化计算新阶段】

【ArweaveOasis 讯】2025 年 6月8日，柏林 -- @ArweaveEco 中的关键计算协议 #HyperBEAM 于今日发布其 Milestone 3 的 Beta 1 版本，标志着去中心化计算平台向可信、高性能执行环境的全面演进。此次更新重点在于支持 AO legacynet 进程在 HyperBEAM 节点上运行，并正式推出名为 “~greenzone@1.0” 的保密计算模块。

@samecwilliams 在发布时发表了长篇内容，介绍 Milestone 3 Beta 1 版本允许现有 AO 进程通过 HyperBEAM 节点中的 AO-Core hashpath 暴露程序状态，使外部系统能够通过 HTTP 访问这些进程的数据。这一机制提升了系统的可组合性和可观察性，为构建更复杂的去中心化应用奠定基础。

值得关注的是，“~greenzone@1.0” 模块的引入，为 HyperBEAM 网络带来了基于 AMD TEE（可信执行环境）的共享密钥机制。运行在合规硬件上的多个节点能够在不暴露私钥的前提下，共同验证计算结果的一致性，从而在无需信任单点的情况下实现可信计算。该密钥不会为任何人类知晓，仅用于系统内部的签名验证。目前，“~greenzone@1.0” 已开启公开测试，但 Sam 提醒，该测试暂不适用于金融交易等正式场景。

为鼓励开发者参与测试，HyperBEAM 提供了公用路由器👉（https://t.co/qbfSgz3gxR），允许具备支持硬件的节点接入网络并在测试 AO 子账本中获取计算报酬。 Sam 表示，相关部署工具和文档已开放，未来几日内将进一步简化部署流程。

虽然 AO-Core 的主要执行机制在本版本中保持稳定，但此次更新包含了约 30,000 行代码的新增内容，包括多个新设备的支持以及架构层级的优化。此外，官方已在 permaweb 上发布了更新后的开发文档，为构建基于 HyperBEAM 的应用提供支持。

HyperBEAM 是构建在 Arweave 永久存储基础之上的去中心化计算协议，通过将计算任务分发至分布式节点网络，致力于打造无需信任、可验证、高可用的执行平台。Milestone 3 Beta 1 的发布，进一步巩固了其作为去中心化操作系统核心组件的地位。

完整的版本说明将于该里程碑最终合并至主分支时同步公布。此次更新亦作为对 Arweave 网络成立七周年的献礼，展现出整个生态系统在可计算性与信任最小化方向上的持续探索与创新。 AI

【Ultraviolet 正式亮相：首个部署在 HyperBEAM 上的 EVM 链】

2025 年 5 月 23 日 — @useload 推出了首个在 @aoTheComputer 上的 EVM 兼容链 —— #Ultraviolet。

Ultraviolet 将以太坊虚拟机（EVM）的开发标准与 #HyperBEAM 的并行计算架构结合，旨在突破传统链的性能限制。
该链定位为 Load network （@useload）生态的“母星”，不仅支持现有 Solidity 智能合约的无缝迁移，也为更高性能和复杂逻辑的去中心化应用提供了新可能。

In the words of Dr. Gavin Wood ...

"Bitcoin pioneered resilience.
Ethereum generalized it.
Polkadot took it one step further with scale."

Here’s how Polkadot rollups are pioneering Web3 for the world.

The Internet was first created for the public, but built in private.

Centralized architectures enabled the monetization of personal data.

Powerful organizations emerged and built the internet that everyone depends on today.

Single points of failure.
No privacy.
No transparency.

The Fix:

Create a resilient system accessible to everyone and not controlled by small groups-

Enter Polkadot and its ecosystem of rollups (parachains).
Natively integrated.
Flexible.
No compromise on decentralization or security.

Polkadot Rollup Key Features:

Shared security. Cut costs, boost security, and enable features e.g. cross-chain functionality.

Native interop. Seamless integration into the Polkadot eco. Perfect for app chains and network effects between projects.

Customization (Polkadot SDK). Builders can quickly deploy apps, maintain autonomy over their chain, and tap into modularity to meet requirements.

Performance. Fast blocktimes/finality and huge throughput from Polkadot's architecture and upgrades such as Async Backing, Agile Coretime, + more.

And it's all decentralized (resilient) thanks to finality & OpenGov on the Polkadot Relay Chain.

Compare that to alternative stacks ...
Performance stats (so far):

→ 143K TPS (Polkadot SDK on Kusama)
→ 173 Nakamoto coefficient
→ 100% on-chain governance
→ 0 Relay Chain downtime since 2020 launch

But Polkadot today is not the end goal. Not even close.

Builders are iterating, pushing on-chain performance to the limits, then setting new limits, incorporating compatibility with other Web3 tech stacks, and more.

【Sam Williams 阐述 Arweave 打造 “Permaweb” 愿景，引领数字未来新方向】

2025 年 6 月 9 日，柏林 -- @ArweaveEco 创始人，生态重要推动者 @samecwilliams 在 X 上发表了备受关注的推文，详细阐述了 #Arweave 在构建去中心化 “Permaweb” 中的核心作用。这一愿景不仅挑战了当前中心化互联网的弊端，还为人类数字化未来的发展指明了新的方向。

Arweave：从数据存储到网络治理的革命
@samecwilliams 表示，Arweave 不仅仅是一个去中心化的永久数据存储解决方案，更是通过其独特的证明访问机制（Proof of Access）和 AO 协议，奠定了构建中立、不可变的网络基础。

他指出，随着人类平均花费约 50% 的清醒时间在线（根据 2024 年 Nielsen 报告），网络空间已逐渐成为人类的“第二大脑”。然而，当前以 DNS 和 IP 协议为基础的中心化网络，使得少数实体能够随意操控用户体验，甚至通过算法封禁账户 —— 如 2022 年 MIT Technology Review 报道的 500 多个社交媒体账号禁令案例。

为了应对这一趋势，Sam 提出 “Permaweb” 概念：一个以用户权利为核心的数字世界，其规则透明、不可更改，类似于现实世界中坚韧的宪法体系。Arweave 作为底层协议，通过确保数据的永久性存储，消除了中心化平台对内容的单方面控制，而 AO 则为这一生态注入了动态性，使其能够支持多样化的去中心化应用。

“Zoom Out”：从技术到全球愿景的升华
在后续推文中，Sam 使用 “zoom out”（拉远视角）这一表述，呼吁关注这一技术背后的更广阔图景。
他强调，Arweave 的发展不仅是技术创新，更是人类社会在数字化时代的一次关键抉择：
💊 接受中心化网络的随意统治？
🌟 还是拥抱一个保障自由表达和隐私的去中心化未来？
这一观点与 2023 年 V-Dem 研究所的数据相呼应，该研究显示全球 67% 的互联网用户面临不同程度的网络审查。

Sam 进一步指出，@fwdresearch 等组织正日夜奋战，推动 Arweave 生态的扩展。这一努力不仅关乎技术实现，更承载着为全球用户创造一个公平、自由网络空间的使命。他呼吁更多开发者、研究者和用户加入这一运动，共同塑造一个“数字宪法”时代。

对 Arweave 发展的积极展望
Sam 的愿景为 Arweave 提供了清晰的发展蓝图。未来，Arweave 生态有望通过以下方向进一步壮大：

🛠️ 技术升级：结合芯片级计算（如推文中提到的潜在硬件合作），提升网络效率和可访问性，吸引更多企业级应用。

🌏 全球合作：与更多去中心化组织和区块链项目合作，扩大 “Permaweb” 的国际影响力。

🎓 用户教育：通过推广工具，增强普通用户对去中心化网络的理解和参与度，构建更广泛的社区支持。

尽管道路漫长，但随着 @fwdresearch 等团队的努力，以及全球开发者的加入，这一愿景正在逐步变为现实。 AI

Breaking into smart contract security is non trivial

Audit reports or bounty writeups?
Using Hardhat or Foundry? 
Taking {X} course or Secureum?
Using Echidna or Medusa for fuzzing?
Participate in Code4rena or other platforms
Specialize in ZK or Cosmos?

Fundamentals are more important than technologies:   

- having an adversarial mindset is more important than reading reports or bounty writeups   

- understanding when to use batch or streaming is more important than Flink vs Spark Streaming  

- understanding how to write tests and notice blind spots in tests is more important than being competent in hardhat or foundry

 - understanding financial aspects of the protocols is more important than taking a course

- understanding what fuzz testing truly means is more important than Echidna vs Medusa

- participating in contests is more important than C4 vs other platforms

- unless you have a solid baseline knowledge, that's more important than specializing

if you understand the concepts and the experience, it’ll be much easier to decide what to do when you are in an analysis paralysis AI

如果策略本身就是协议呢？

这就是@TheoriqAI
用Alpha Protocol打造的东西。

它不是一个仪表盘。它是一个群体。

每个代理只有一个任务：观察、制定策略、执行、评估——而且它们会相互交流。就像我钱包里的一个DeFi团队。

无需代码。无需猜测。我只需要告诉它我想要什么——被动收益、资本轮换、流动性提供者保护——然后群体会处理剩下的事情。

最疯狂的部分？

每一步都在链上。每次改进都是迭代的。而且我用得越多，它就越聪明。

这不是自动化。
这是机器规模的协调。

text:
Crypto’s Fork in the Road

Right now crypto is at a crossroads, and it’s one of the most exciting times to be a builder creating long term value over short term gains.

There’s been a paradigm shift in the “playbook” for successful projects. The meta for years prior was to ship half-assed products, raise VC rounds at multi-billion dollar valuations for vaporware infra, juice vanity metrics and unload your bags on unsuspecting retail at the Binance listing. This is probably a major reason why everyone on CT complains that there are almost no useful products in crypto. Dubious “investors” knowingly fund bad teams for quick flips, reinforcing a cycle of extraction and cynicism.

This all changed with the meteoric rise of Hyperliquid. Finally you had a team that was locked in, trying to solve a real problem, and who refused to bend the knee to the crypto cartels. They won over their community by consistently making choices that benefited real users not airdrop farmers, and a $40Bn airdrop was simply the cherry on top. When I met Jeff I was amazed by his dedication to the mission and low ego, and taken aback that they didn’t employ a single marketing person - their community had become their outsourced mouthpiece. This shift in perception is leading to a huge swing in investors seeking quality amongst the noise, and founders similarly honing in on real, revenue-generating applications with PMF.

Furthermore, it’s encouraging to see DEXs scoop up market share with every week that passes. Centralized exchange listings promise distribution, but can be the death sentence for promising but unwitting projects, often charging up to 20% of supply along with notorious perp short-selling (the Alameda special). With DEX launches, projects get day one distribution to millions of users on networks like Solana, with less middlemen, predatory listing fees and opaque market making deals. On-chain is the new direct-to-consumer.

It too seems like the macro tides are shifting in favour of a crypto world. New policies are rolling in for offerings like stablecoins, major spot ETFs are being filed, and huge M&A deals from web2 titans are announced every other week.

The future of crypto will not be built by those who mastered the old game. It will be built by those who have the courage to play a different one entirely. I have nothing but the upmost respect for founders like @aeyakovenko  and @chameleon_jeff  who envisioned a better future, ignored the noise of the market, and executed their roadmap like their life depended on it. They serve as the prime example that if you want to build something generational, you must take the road less traveled. AI

$Mixie 最近涨得挺猛，但不只是炒题材那么简单。它想做的是 AI x 金融工具平台。——让普通用户和项目方都能用 AI 来创建资产、搭建应用。

就好比你在 Web2 要用 Notion、Zapier 组合搞自动化，Mixie 是想做 Web3 里最简单好用的 AI 工具。零代码，还能一站式解决分发和变现问题。跟其他空喊 AI 的项目不一样，Mixie 是真的在做“能用的 AI 产品」。

团队背景也不弱，CEO Matt Morgan 不光是多个九位数项目的操盘手，还在给 @worldlibertyfi  当顾问。而且 Mixie 这次直接被纳入了纳斯达克上市公司结构，这是 Web3 里少见的操作，意味着它以后能合法接触到美股的融资通路。

目前市值在 AI 赛道属于明显低估，昨天是在一个相对低点位置想给大家分享，工作在手 tge 前的冲刺忙碌，今天看已经到了 60 m 了，而且 Solana meme 圈也开始注意它了。

你可以当它是下一个从链上玩梗走向传统资本市场的项目，也可以把它当成一条从游戏、AI 叙事通往真正落地产品的主线。总之，@MixieUpdates的故事刚刚开始！ AI

text:
Honestly the one rewarding thing about being so outspoken on my perspectives in this space is you can check my timeline and see when I am right and when I am wrong and it's a nice feeling when I'm right.

Everyones finally being honest because they can't profit off this hyper rotative attention capital market that favors KOL dominance so strongly.

But I told you literally 7-8 months ago this is exactly where we would head and there was a point of 'no return' if people didn't start holding people accountable.

Now we've finally reached the singularity of it all, KOLs turning on each other because they won't help each other pump bags, when they have to.
People turning on KOLs because there's not enough exit liqudity left to win by just mindlessly copy trading them. 

Bulk liquidity in the trenches has been pretty much entirely cycled into the hands of KOL scan traders and people in their groupchats.

The big issue with that point is; trenches need liquidity to get coins out of the trenches so people with lined pockets will buy them at higher prices. However, we can't do that anymore because 
A: Not enough liquidity.
B: Not enough conviction.
C: Not enough attention to go around.

Trenches will be cooked until we get a massive liquidity event, like an airdrop.

The only coins that have a hope of actually doing 9 figure runs right now are coins with genuine communities who believe in the coin. You need a group of uber retards, risking 100% of their bag for 0 or hero so the sell pressure is low enough to crack 10-15m so that 'whales' who prefer buying 'proven' stuff with size at higher prices, can deploy their capital.

But as I said, we don't even have enough liquidity to put coins there half the time and certainly not enough retention of attention on coins to let them stay at 10m long enough for whales to feel comfortably in sizing it.

Most of you don't actually understand the underlying dynamics of the market you're trading in and how the money flows and how coins run because you really just sit here and click buttons praying to get lucky by clicking the right one at the right time, it is a casino after all so I can't fault such behavior, but you have actively constructed walls that have ruined your chances of success and instead skewed them in favour of random anons on the internet with heaps of followers that could give 0 fucks about you.

I said it 8 months ago, I'll say it again now.

You need to take back control of your autonomy, go find a coin you like, disable all your dumb wallet tracking, buy the coin, move it into a dead wallet and dont touch it for weeks, get on the  timeline or x community and talk about it once or twice a day, help with raids, whatever it is. Start behaving autonomously without regard for others and encourage everyone you know to do the same.

Will it potentially be unprofitable initially almost certainly, but who knows what happens by the end of month one if everyone actually begins to change their behavior. AI

The guy wearing a suit would then tell me his boring ideas of mainstream mass-adoption and getting big banks onboard. This happened all the time, and the business guys even attempted a hostile takeover of Bitcoin.

Mass adoption is a meme that means "build a bad product to pump my bags". It's the same mindset of trashy US startups where the aim is to grab money, stuff your org with HR and marketing and "fake it till you make it" mindset.

Now today we see people calling for a return to the core principles at the heart of cryptocurrency's journey in 2010.

What can we learn from the history of Linux?

The movement started in the early 90s, but had its roots much earlier. Richard Stallman saw the influx of VCs into the PC industry in the 80s, and the culture completely changed.

People stopped caring about computer freedom. So he proposed a big mission: lets create a new operating system. People called him crazy and a crank, but he didn't listen to them. Stallman invented the Linux operating system.

As the movement start gaining traction, soon the money people came back again. We need mass adoption they said.

They also said this: "talking about freedom is scary for big business. We need to tone that down and focus just on the benefits for business."

This was the origin of opensource. It was created to push Stallman out of the movement he created, and attract big business.

We saw the same thing happen in crypto. Corrupt people who benefit from money printing said "if only we can wrestle this Bitcoin thing out of the hands of the anarchists, then we can get mainstream adoption by big banks".

Opensource pumped big time on the stock market during the 90s, but then cooled off and eventually the markets got bored and moved on.

The Linux movement stalled, and the big meme in the Linux community became mass adoption. Notice the similarity here with crypto? Big money coming in but nothing new happening. Then people get bored and the movement dies, failing to achieve its objective.

Linux became a poor man's alternative to Windows and Mac. It tried to play catch up always copying its competitor, and being one step behind.

Worst yet, we missed the rise of mobile and Linux was left behind scrambling.

But that's changing in the Linux community. And I'm sensing crypto is also about to undergo this character arc.

The Linux renaissance was first sparked by outrage over systemd, but now people are getting back to the heart of Linux.

Linux is not Windows or Mac. Linux is Linux.

With Linux you can make infrastructure. Linux runs communities and gives you economic and social power. You are in charge. Everyone is a main character- you are developer and user.

By contrast, Windows and Mac are for cucks. You are enslaved. If you are locked out or experience injustice, you can only send the big tech corporation an angry email. You have no power. They make the decisions, and you live with them.

Worst yet, they don't care about people rallying to fix their situation. They spy on you and sell your data to corporations and governments. You are the product.

Linux is power. Cypherpunks use Linux.

Imagine an authoritarian regime comes to power and puts your friends in jail. They are oppressing you.

Are you going to use Google Docs and your Mac to overthrow the regime? Nope!

You will want anonymous freedom tech but it will be too late since you did not develop your skills. Think of it like prepping for the apocalypse, but rather than stockpiling tins of food, you're acquiring hard skills which your community will need when SHTF.

Understand anon, this is the true purpose and power of cryptocurrency too. Anonymous, uncensored and sovereign economic networks.

Cryptocurrency is power. You can send money from anywhere in the world to anywhere else fully anonymously using Monero and nobody can stop you. We can even form anonymous on-chain DAOs with DarkFi, mobilize to gather funds and act together as one powerful voice in the market. Nobody can stop this.

They might put any one of us in jail, or suicide us like what happened with Ross Ulbricht and John McAfee, but the ball is rolling and crypto is primed for a renaissance.

I remember telling everyone in 2000 the governments were spying on everyone. I downloaded OpenCV library and made an app in 10 mins to track my face on a webcam. Then I read how London has the highest number of CCTV cameras in the world. I put two and two together, and it made sense, right?

WRONG. People all called me a conspiracy theorist and gave me strange looks. I tried telling everybody, but nobody believed me.

Then the @Snowden disclosures happened, and suddenly everybody was saying "the government's spying on you!"... well duh! Hackers had been saying this for years!

But now the Overton window has shifted. People have woken up to the elites in power and their lies. The politicians used black magic and manipulated people. But black magic has a cost that must be repaid in the future and now their lies are catching up with them. People no longer believe anything the media says. It's all lies.

We are searching for the path forwards together. Crypto is meant to be a boat carrying us through the storm.

Things are about to change. There is a deep desire burning beneath the surface.

We need to research, educate, spread the message, run nodes and write code. Learn philosophy/history and hard skills. Make video, movies and write. Actually run nodes, use Linux and write code. Even if you won't be a coder, still learn to write code and participate actively as a user. We need to rally and organize as a community around agorist cypherpunk values.

We need to create orgs dedicated to change and train the next gen of leaders. We need to create strategy and take action. We need to write code and ship products. We need to fight everyday with all our energy for freedom.

text:
Today I got to experience something I dreamed up four years ago.

Back when @web3princess and I were figuring out what chain to build @BAXUSco on, I had this vision: decentralized capital formation, real-world assets tokenized as NFTs, DAOs actually governing those NFTs, and tokens being used to decide the fate of those assets.

Today, all of that came together.

Internet Capital Markets at their finest. A new kind of DAO on @Solana.

Introducing: the Decentralized Alcoholic Organizaation, a whiskey-backed DAO launched on @daosdotfun.

The governance token is called $DRINK, and it’s backed by actual barrels of whiskey traded on BAXUS.

This isn’t just a novelty. It’s a glimpse of where things are headed.
How we build. How we trade. How we coordinate capital online.

Whiskey has always been America’s cryptocurrency. Its original proof-of-work.

Grain, fire, water, and oak all locked in a barrel with nothing but time. You can’t fake it. You can’t rush it. You wait. And what comes out on the other side is deeper, better, and more valuable.

That’s proof-of-work.

Long before crypto or venture capital, whiskey was already a store of value. A way for farmers to preserve the grain they worked hard to grow, but couldn’t store for years. Whiskey became that store. Traded. Bartered. Hoarded. Floated down rivers. A physical hedge, deflationary and appreciating over time.

It’s scarce. It matures. It carries stories and status.

So what happens when you bring that onchain?

With $DRINK, the DAO will use presale and LP fees to buy, hold, and trade real barrels of whiskey on BAXUS, the tokenized spirits marketplace we’ve been building since 2021.

Holders of $DRINK govern the treasury: deciding whether to age, blend, flip, or bottle.

The barrels sit in bonded warehouses. The tokens live onchain. But their lifecycle is shaped by the DAO.

Over time, the DAO will begin distributing real bottles to holders, not just as perks, but as something deeper: Proof of Drink (more on that in another post).

This isn’t about artificial scarcity. It’s about closing the loop between holding and enjoying. Between onchain coordination and real-world connection. Between value stored and value shared.

This is what BAXUS, https://t.co/aSW6mUZD3Q, and Solana were made for, novel capital formation around new asset classes, traded in marketplaces that couldn’t exist until now.

In this new world, the line between “community” and “capital market” evaporates faster than the angel’s share.

$DRINK is a prototype for what real asset-backed DAOs can be:
• Tangible, time-sensitive assets governed by taste
• Votes that actually matter
• Treasuries that yield not just APY, but bottles
• Portfolios shaped by belief, narrative, and lived experience

It’s weird. It’s real. And it’s fun in a way that actually matters.

If you’ve ever wanted to own a barrel, start your whiskey journey, and join a global crew of collectors and drinkers, here’s your chance:

👉 https://t.co/wZ47NjUpS1

If you want early access to the pre-sale: start buying bottles on BAXUS.

Let’s make liquid gold liquid again.
Let’s make crypto fun again.
Let’s $DRINK. 🥃 AI

text:
I’ve been building in web3 for 10 years now — started back in 2014 on Ethereum, before it became popular and before the wave of scam ICOs. Over the following five years, I found a technically superior alternative: Polkadot. With my team, we’ve completed the foundational layer of a web3+robotics on Polkadot cloud.

But I’m struggling to get community support because the project what we build doesn’t have staking, airdrops, or token-shilling marketing. Every resource we have goes into development — over 70 GitHub repositories have been created to explore and implement the concept of a web3 cloud for managing smart devices and robots.

As a result, I’m in a place where the community simply doesn’t understand why a decentralized cloud for robots and IoT even matters. If there’s no staking, no easy token farming just for turning something on for 15 minutes — then it’s not interesting. For three years now — out of my twelve in crypto — I’ve been trying to understand why the values of privacy, independence from data centers, and building the future of the internet have fallen out of focus. And I still can’t find the answer. 

Still, I want to keep trying to bring the best technologies into the world — technologies that can truly improve modern life. Whether people around me understand it or not, any episode of Black Mirror could become reality in 2025 — or even tomorrow. I'm tired, and I've spent my personal savings to get this far, but I still hold on to one hope: that someday, even if it’s just a small number of people across the planet, they’ll be protected from Big Brother. And if that happens — that alone will mean the world to me. AI

I hear talk about people capitulating all over these days. Other people capitulating is your opportunity. At none of crypto's pivotal moments was it easy. At bottoms, there was always talk of lower. During forks there was always talk of chain destruction. We now find ourselves in another not-so-easy moment. If that makes you emotional, that's okay, sit with the emotion, observe it, and then decide what to do with it. With some patience, you can make it... 

While there is always a risk of lower, I continue to believe this is a mid-bull pullback and that we haven't seen "cycle top." $BTC giving up a bit more ground isn't going to change that view. Selling here is unlikely to be a good idea if you're wavering - because if you're selling here, it also tells me you're prone to get sidelined on the way up. At worst, just sit on your hands, don't even look at prices if it helps and you're not going to do anything anyway. If you have any dry powder left, add bits here and there if things look really attractive to you, or when you feel sickest. NFA, just sharing my two sats. 

It looks to me like alts led BTC, BTC led equities. Equities might have some more shaking out to do, but remember this: BTC and cryptoassets are the fastest horses in finance, to the downside and upside. If equities go soft enough, measures will be taken to avoid any major or systemic weakness, because Trump's favorite scoreboard is the stock market -- and cryptoassets will feel those measures most acutely.

If you get out of crypto due to fear, or trying to be too cute, you will get whiplash on the other side of this. Don't listen to the traders that are always perfect - they're liars. People making significant money rarely brag about how much money they make. I make mistakes all the time, but a key for me has always been staying significantly allocated to multi-decadal growth stories. In a sense, I always go partially down with the ship, while storing some reserves in lifeboats when times are good (read: take profit the next time you feel an urge to gloat). 

Beyond liquidity injections, rate adjustments, and macro at large, right now is an incredibly exciting time for blockchains. They're finally getting the (inter)national respect they deserve, and all kinds of formidable teams are working on projects to bring blockchain applications deeper (and seamlessly) into the social fabric. Only last year did institutions really get the green light from Uncle Sam to play ball.

All these things take time - hang in there magic money friends. AI

•⁠  ⁠On continue les streaks Ethos et Fantasy (argent gratos) et les games sur Abstract.

Ce soir @TheSmolTalk 17h30, puis gros lives Abstract ✳️ hate de vous retrouver

On est ENSEMBLE comme JAJA la famass 🫶
Jeudi, on grind on grind, on griiiiiiiiind 🔥 AI

雖然現在有很多人說Solana的DeFi很無聊，但只要你深掘就可以找到不少機會。今天想說@NX_Finance合作的一個項目方 @fragmetric，作為一個小「精算師」，如何掘到87% 的空投收益？

什麼是Fragmetric？
Fragmetric是在 @solana 上的restaking項目，你可以把 $SOL 換取 $fragSOL 代幣，同時獲取積分

誰在支持他們？
Solana 聯合創始人 Anatoly Yakovenko、Solana 基金會主席 Lily Liu、Jito Labs 創始人 Lucas Bruder、Backpack 聯合創始人 Tristan，甚至 Wintermute 的 Yoann Turpin，都投資了 Frametric。還有 Finality Capital Partners、Hashed、Rockaway Capital 等機構也有投資

積分系統:
現在Fragmetric  有 300 億積分，即將以 2 億美元 FDV 售 NFT，這意味著距離TGE也不遠了。這時候如果用@NX_Finance 進行10 倍槓桿積分的機會能加倍放大收益，舉個例子：

1⃣存 1 個 fragSOL，用 10 倍槓桿
2⃣需要支付 17% 的 SOL 借貸利息,fragSOL 質押可以賺 8-11%。
3⃣每天可以賺 2580 個 f-point

⏩SOL 價格 160 美元，每天淨利息成本 0.35 美元，
⏩假設最終積分35B + 5% 空投 + 200M FDV,積分價值 0.73 美元
⏩這相當於 87% 的 APR!

為什麼選 NX Finance並非YT？
相比其他平台 (如 Exponent 的 YT) ，我們的優勢在於靈活性。不倫 Fragmetric 在一週內 TGE，或是拖到 2-3 個月後，用戶都可以隨時進出倉位，不用擔心市場變化。

text:
Blaming SOL for the fraud & scams that occur there is a brain-dead take;

This always happens to permissionless chains that rise to a dominant position 🔥

In 2014, it was BTC scams & criminal markets. In 2017 ETH ICOs & in 2021 it was ETH NFTs!

SOL is the BTC & ETH of 2025: 🧵

Scammers & criminals will always seek out the cutting-edge, as it is on this frontier where they can extract the most, just like the Wild West of old

Does that make the frontier bad? Ofcourse not, in the same way, that BTC & ETH were not bad during their heydays

A truly decentralized, permissionless & public blockchain cannot block criminals, scams & fraud...

That is the trade-off we make for freedom, truly making it the home of the brave; if you cannot stomach that, go back to centralized products!

The early internet was much the same, with a much higher proportion of criminal activity, scams & fraud that we see today. Over time, with mainstream adoption, this was watered down & consumer protections were improved. Making the internet a much more respectable place today compared to when it was in its infancy

Most also do not realize that pornography drove a lot of the internet's growth, specifically the acceleration of innovation around capacity, speed & more:

I have never endorsed memecoins & I likely never will as a research-led fundamental value investor

However, the analogy to pornography & the early internet is uncanny, even if it is often distasteful. I am not in the business of denying reality; I am in the business of uncovering & discovering reality

A major difference to the internet is that crypto is not a single protocol, but thousands all competing over dominance & adoption. This free market dynamic is powerful & even though it drives a lot of evil in our world, the net effect is still positive. Free market competition drives innovation & exerts "evolutionary pressure". This, however, does mean we are cycling through dominant chains over time. First, it was BTC, then it was ETH & now it is SOL! I value freedom & am willing to accept a certain degree of chaos & danger in return

The truth is that SOL is now leading the cryptocurrency movement, whether we like it or not!

The high frequency of scams & fraud are only additional signs of this dominance, along with the undeniable usage metrics, where SOL is clearly leading

SOL's leadership has also been relatively responsible, as they have been putting their audience's attention & focus on real projects, for which there are plenty on SOL. As a matter of fact, the application revenue for SOL is now higher than all other chains combined! (5.8M in the last 24H!)

Again, I have never endorsed meme coins & never will. However, one of the reasons for PumpFun's success has exactly been because it is more fair than most of the alternatives out there. The platform itself guarantees that there is no pre-sale & no team allocation; this is why some of the biggest meme coin scams were not launched on PumpFun! We all need to inject a bit more nuance & detail into these conversations; nothing is ever clearly black or white, good or evil:

I also suspect that the recent meme coin mania was driven by the sorry state of our industry. a lot of people perceive meme coins as a less rigged game compared to the VC-infested waters of "mainstream" crypto. Where the majority of the supply is now often controlled by insiders...

We should bring ICOs back at scale now that the regulatory environment can support that again. Since at least that gave retail the same opportunity as the VCs participating at a ground level

Either way, blaming SOL for this recent mania is completely misguided; if anything, we should be thankful that somebody was able to pick the ball back up after ETH fumbled it. We should care about the adoption of decentralized blockchain infrastructure; I am not so petty as to oppose this adoption surge by totally opposing SOL

There is plenty to criticize SOL for, but supporting fraud, scams & fraud is not it. That is a tired argument that I have countered for over 12 years now, both in defense of BTC, ETH & now SOL in turn. Do not be like the sour BTC maxis of 2017, denying reality as their usage metrics are flipped by ETH. Constantly moving the goalposts of success until they became a pet rock

Realism & an adherence to empirical evidence inform our position, love or hate SOL. You cannot deny its prominence; this is why Trump launched on SOL; no other chain had the infrastructure to support that sort of scale overnight

Based on crypto's history, there is a good chance that there will be a different dominant blockchain, in a few years from now. That blockchain will also most likely host the majority of fraud, scams & criminality. This has always been the case & most likely always will

SOL is no angel, but it is also certainly not a devil ☯️ AI

text:
我的產業調查指出，關於Jony Ive與OpenAI合作的新型態AI硬體裝置：
1. 預計將在2027年量產。
2. 將在非中國組裝與出貨，以降低地緣政治風險。目前預計在越南組裝。
3. 目前樣品的外觀體積略大於AI Pin，外關設計猶如iPod Shuffle般小巧精緻。上述設計與規格在量產前可能還會有變化。
4. 其中一個使用方式是將此裝置掛在脖子上。
5. 將配備相機與麥克風，可偵測外接環境，不具備顯示功能。
6. 預計需與手機跟PC連結，並利用手機與PC的運算與顯示功能。

我認為OpenAI選擇在此時官方公佈與Jony Ive的合作，其中一個目的可能是想轉移市場對剛結束的Google I/O之注意力。Google I/O演說中強調的Google生態與AI整合之優勢，是OpenAI現階段無法抗衡的，故OpenAI用不同的主題分散市場注意力。

但AI走入現實生活 (也就是所謂的實體/物理AI) 已是市場公認的下一個AI關鍵趨勢，Jony Ive與Open AI的合作成功與否仍需觀察，但這也反映上述趨勢。此合作也讓我想起Alan Kay的名言：People who are really serious about software should make their own hardware。 AI

> HyperBEAM：运行 AO-Core 的去中心化平台，它允许大家用自己设备去执行 AO 程序
> TEE (可信执行环境)：一种基于硬件隔离的安全计算环境，保护数据和代码的机密性与完整性。
> Green Zone：HyperBEAM 上基于 TEE 的隐私计算环境，允许多个节点在完全隔离的环境中协作计算。

2⃣那么，这次的 HyperBEAM Milestone 3 更新有什么核心亮点：

> 支持 AO “老进程”运行：实现“向后兼容”，以前写的 AO 进程现在能在 HyperBEAM 网络中运行。
> 通过 HTTP 访问程序状态：每个程序的状态可以通过“网址”（HTTP hashpath）访问，像访问 API 一样查看 AO 程序的运行情况。
> 引入 Green Zone @1.0 (隐私计算环境)：使用 AMD TEE 确保节点在“安全环境”中运行，多节点共享一个“隐形私钥”进行验证，无人可见，但全网可验证；实现安全、保密、可验证的协同计算。
> 开放测试网络：所有符合硬件要求的设备都可以加入测试网络。（测试地址路由器见 github）
> 模拟奖励机制启动：完成用户计算任务可获得测试奖励，使用 AO 的“子账本”（subledger）进行记账和激励分配。
> 底层系统大升级：代码库新增约 30,000 行代码；多个模块、设备与功能增强，稳定性和性能大幅提升。

对于开发者来说，HyperBEAM OS 提供了工具包，帮助快速加入 Green Zone 测试。后续团队还会继续更新文档、简化部署和开发流程，帮助更多开发者「共建」。 AI

Gros TST 🎙️, puis gros live ce soir 📹✳️

L’asset est bien trop strong, le narratif aussi. 
Tous les pavelards, toute l’euphorie récente n’auront pas réussi à call le top vu que ATH de plus 🚀
Asset du cycle ? Seul nouvel asset qui tiendra dans le temps ? 
C’est l’idée que je m’en fais de plus en plus. 
Ce qui veut pas dire d’aller top blast, mais que c’est au moins un écosystème à surveiller et qui risque de continuer à surprendre si le marché continue dans ce sens 🤞
Je vais me placer sur les tranchees et NFTs HL comme un porc.

👉 Sincèrement, mes convictions sur @megaeth_labs sont de plus en plus fortes. 
D’ailleurs, on va commencer à faire des lives plus fréquents dessus. 
J’ai envie qu’on digg plus, qu’on vous offre plus d’opportunités de rencontres avec les gros builders. 
On a commencé avec @0xBreadguy et on va continuer fort. 
Et y aura comme d’hab de l’ETH testnet à distribuer aux fidèles pour aller s’amuser sur le testnet, et d’autres cadeaux qui sait 👀🎁
Ps : pour ceux qui lisent bien, un petit 1ETH testnet à prendre ici aussi allez, qui le veut et pourquoi ? 

👉 Évidemment on oublie pas le fun, les lives @AbstractChain qui continuent ✳️
Je sais que ça a un peu ralenti ces dernières semaines, 
Mais justement. 
J’ai mes convictions intactes sur le $PENGU et sur Luca, et j’pense que c’est le moment PARFAIT pour double down. 
Je sais que la famAbs le fait déjà, donc je le dos pour ceux qui se demandaient quand s’y mettre car avaient fade. 

👉 On continue la routine, notamment @ethos_network qui a commencé sa nouvelle saison et qui pour moi reste un cook facile même pour les petits porte feuilles. 
Mais on lâchera pas fantasy, les games Abstract, les grind discord etc.. 

Une semaine de ZINZIN qui démarre, un gros @TheSmolTalk CROUSTIBAT puis un live aux petits oignons ✳️

On est ENSEMBLE comme JAJA la famass 🫶
Nouvelle semaine, nouvelles opportunités de tout faire pour make it 🔥 AI

又一个喜欢的项目有yap活动了。@Mira_Network  上线了Kaito Yapper排行榜，仅凭在推特上谈论Mira就能瓜分250万美元奖励池。前200名Yapper能分走总供应量的0.5%，按照其900万美元种子轮融资和5亿美元FDV估算，排名靠前的用户单纯靠"嘴撸"就能赚到$2000-$5000？

发此文正好测试下硬核文在积攒Mindshare过程中的吸引力。为什么一个AI基础设施项目会拿出重金做头部yapper激励？答案可能藏在Mira要解决的那个"holy grail"级别的问题里。散户视角下，技术确实复杂抽象了一些。

——破解AI"一本正经胡说八道"的死结

老实说，我对Mira的兴趣点一直在于其技术路径的独特性。当前AI系统最大的痛点是什么？幻觉和偏见。ChatGPT再聪明，偶尔也会一本正经地胡说八道，这背后的根本原因是什么？

AI模型本质上做的是"概率游戏"，而不是"理解游戏"。当遇到训练数据覆盖不够的领域时，AI会进行"创造性补全"；而概率采样的随机性天然决定了结果的不确定性。这让AI在金融交易、医疗诊断等高精度场景中始终无法被完全信任。

传统解决方案都在单一模型上做文章，而Mira提出了一种截然不同的思路：用去中心化共识来验证AI输出。既然单一模型靠不住，那就用"群体智慧"来纠错。那要怎么做？

具体机制是将AI输出拆解成可验证的"声明对"，分发给去中心化的验证节点网络，通过N/M共识协议确定真伪。更详细的流程包括：

1）将AI输出拆解成独立的"声明对"（Entity -> Claim）；
2）分发给由不同AI模型组成的去中心化节点网络进行验证；
3）通过N/M共识协议确定声明有效性；
4）生成加密证书记录验证结果；
5）用PoW/PoS混合机制激励诚实验证，惩罚作恶节点。

测试数据显示，这套机制能将AI输出准确率提升到95.6%，基本达到了高精度应用场景的可用标准。

这套逻辑让我想起了区块链早期解决"拜占庭将军问题"的思路，用分布式共识对抗单点故障。只不过这次要解决的是AI的"认知故障"。

——抢占AI基础设施的生态制高点

从生态位来看，Mira的定位相当巧妙。Mira很聪明地避开了算力军备竞赛，专攻"可信度"这个被忽视但关键的环节。想想看，当AI开始处理你的财务规划、法律文件时，你更在乎它算得快，还是算得对？谁敢用一个可能"胡言乱语"的AI系统？Mira提供的去中心化验证机制，恰好填补了这个巨大的信任空白。

而且，这个定位的商业价值正在被验证。Gigabrain交易平台接入Mira后，能够过滤掉不靠谱的AI交易建议；教育平台Learnrite用它来验证AI生成的考试题目；区块链项目Kernel甚至将其共识机制整合到了BNB生态中。

以上。

回到开头的Yapper排行榜，这其实是个聪明的策略：用短期激励撬动长期关注，尤其是对项目背后复杂技术逻辑和意义理解。毕竟，对大部分散户而言，在技术壁垒较高的赛道，如何让更广泛的社区理解项目价值？一波深刻且广泛的社区讨论非常有必要。

虽然Mira尚未公布具体的TGE时间表，但从其加大社区激励力度、上线Yapper排行榜等动作来看，项目想必正在做准备。AI infra赛道竞争日趋激烈，Mira的"去中心化AI验证"能否成为差异化突围的关键，值得持续观察。

Anyway，yap一下吧！ AI

$NYLA

3HeUeL8ru8DFfRRQGnE11vGrDdNUzqVwBW8hyYHBbonk

搞了点 bonk 平台的 AI 龙头，买入并持有。

现在市场的情绪在 meme 板块，AI 类型的大多数都在被集体看低。 

$NYLA 也是其中一个被严重低估的标的。刚好趁现在行情一般，做下仔细的投研。

快速总结版：
1. 算是 bonk 平台官方定性的 AI 龙头
2. Dev 和 Tom 关系不错，Tom 最后一笔买入，是 $NYLA
3. 专门请了美术做 IP，一直产出 meme 图和视频
4. 有社区集体换头像，有裂变预期
5. dev 一直在做事，之前画大饼的应用已经陆续落地

整体看好，现在买入足够多的筹码，加入 PVE，远离 PVP，等 AI 情绪复苏收菜。

---

以下是完整部分，后续不再赘述。

1） $NYLA 是 bonk 平台 AI 龙头

一个平台想要走的远，AI 板块是必不可少的，

类似于之前的 BSC，我在白布那会儿就说后面肯定不可能一直围着那两口子转，一定会有 AI 等其他板块起来，果不其然后来就有了 $TST

所以赶在 AI 季之前押注 bonk 平台的 AI 龙头 $NYLA 

---

2）具备 meme 社区裂变属性

 $NYLA 请了专门的美术，做连环漫画和视频，塑造了一个完整的 IP 形象，一直在更新。

并让社区成员统一更换 orange 橘色背景头像和背景图，

有点类似 $MASK 社区币的味道，容易产生更大范围的裂变传播

---

3）dev 很活跃，一直在做事

之前我提到过拉盘二要素：
1.硬实力，砸钱拉盘
2.软实力，靠影响力喊单拉盘

这两者，其实 $NYLA 都具备一定的条件，

首先 K 线一直横住，砸不下去，说明有做市商在护盘。

其次， @shax_btc 跟 @SolportTom 走的很近，bonk 平台在最近其实已经悄悄给 $NYLA 站台一次：

bonk 官号发过一张图，里面只有 3 个标的，$USELESS、 $HOSICO $NYLA

什么意思，其实已经很明显了，基本上算是 bonk 官方定性的 AI 龙头。

除此之外，dev 一直在开发功能和应用，官网一直在更新新东西，说明一定是打算认真做的，上一个这么认真的 dev 是 $ai16z。

---

4）筹码层面

榜一 8% 的筹码是团队锁仓的部分，其他明面上的榜二是 ai16z 鲸鱼转过来的筹码。

并且 @SolportTom 买入的最后一笔，就是 $NYLA

创始人 @shax_btc  还在不断的回购 $NYLA 来加池子

K 线一直控在 3M 左右，感觉在等一波 AI 情绪复苏。

筹码感觉还行。

---

5） $NYLA 的应用之一：推特打赏

现在推特上如果你对某个输出者的内容十分喜欢，想要给他打赏，只有订阅和赠送蓝 v 这两个渠道，十分不灵活和方便，

而 $NYLA 可以直接艾特你喜欢的博主，输入指令，直接打赏 sol，

这个支付场景其实已经有市场需求存在了，例如隔壁 ins 已经在试点稳定币打赏博主，一旦被打通，其实想象空间非常大

6） $NYLA 的应用之一：将推文收录

这个使用场景其实也有需求存在，有一个专门做这个功能的推特号，都做到 100w 粉丝。

可想而知需求是准确且存在的。

---

以上，仅代表个人意见，不构成任何投资意见。

DYOR。 AI

text:
Good morning

Today is a very long start to the day, as I would like to respond in detail to some feedback I have received. It started with this person criticizing @LunaticsBTC. Although this is from an account with only five followers, I would still like to respond to the questions and comments in detail, partly because I can understand the reasoning and frustration behind them.

@GrizzlyBearRune points out that I have released three projects in one year and that all of them have failed. This is almost correct. My first project was Ordinal Bulls in 2023, during the early days of Ordinals. In the past two years, I have released a total of five projects, the most recent of which is Planets. These projects are not visible on the front page of the marketplaces and are certainly not a success for every holder. Many holders are happy with them, and probably a few are not, because they did not generate a profitable return.

Of course, I would have liked to see things turn out differently, but I am proud of every project and that is why I have included them on Creator dot Gallery. In addition, I will give each of my own projects a function in the Planets Galaxy. I have not abandoned any projects. The reality is that, unfortunately, most projects in Ordinals are not financially successful. Or at least not yet.

Then there is the related question of what happened to the money. After the costs were deducted, some of the money was used as income so that I can continue doing what I love most: creating. And most of it was invested in the development of a marketplace and mint platform, Ordinal dot io. This marketplace is almost ready.

Can you see this as extraction? Financially speaking, absolutely. That is unrelated to the amount of money involved. As the founder of a paid collection, you extract money and give artwork in return.

Then the next comment: Planets is AI. I don't need to explain this at length, because the proof is on-chain. No, nothing about Planets is AI. This can all be verified, because the code is on-chain. Planets are 2,100 unique planets and a complete 3D galaxy.

@GrizzlyBearRune indicates that I promote Lunatics more than my own project. And that may well be true, as I am a collector of Lunatics and the creator of my own project. As Founder, my approach is to provide information about my project, but I leave the evaluation to the potential buyer. I am convinced that if my project is good enough and people come into contact with it, I don't need to promote it. Organic growth is the most valuable thing to me and the only way to achieve long-term growth.

Finally, I bought Nikola's OMB so that I could launch more projects. An OMB generally provides more followers, that's no secret, it's reality. It's a community that supports each other and is interested in each other, like-minded people. It also often acts as a kind of stamp of approval. Not only OMB has this “feature,” but other well-known projects do too. It's part of what makes OMB so valuable. But there are more elements, such as the art, the holders' mentality within the community, the iconic and unique character. The culture and the return of social issues in the art. All these things together were reasons for me to buy an OMB. And being able to buy the iconic OMB of someone like Nikola was an opportunity I seized. And with or without OMB, I will launch more collections. AI

This week made me realize how lucky I got with my NFT bag.

@claynosaurz has always been my biggest conviction play in crypto, and as time goes on, my conviction is growing higher and higher.

Most NFT projects from 2-3 years ago, died off or simply failed as they build out their IP (the typical slow rug, not always by intention).

Yet, here I was at Annecy '25, the biggest animation event on the planet, in full support of Claynosaurz and their partnership with Mediawan.

… and god damn, did they crush it.

Seeing Claynosaurz and @MediawanFr host one of the headline events of the week showcases the beginning of a big IP in the making.

With nearly 1000 students attending, and over 100 VIP guests (a mix of Claynosaurz holders, Mediawan execs, potential partners, …) joining. 

Calling this IRL activation a success is an understatement.

To my surprise many students were already following Claynosaurz because of Web2 socials. A clear indicator that the team is getting noticed outside of the Web3 echo chamber.

The Annecy activation was the PERFECT onboarding machine for future talent. I wouldn't be surprised if among these 1000 students there are many high potential animators drafting their resume... ready to apply.

It was honestly the perfect mix of recruitment, marketing, networking,... whilst strengthening the connection between holders. All done in the perfect setting.

Aside from the main event at Le Pop, there were several other occasions where I met collectors, animators and founders.

It's kind of funny if you think about it, the most rare herd out there, is not even digitalized: The Clayno Community. 

Hearing others talk about their mint experience, the collection they are trying to build, seeing so many herd and pod combo's getting flexed, … that's what collecting is all about.

There isn't a better use case for NFTs, than seeing Claynosaurz collectors geek over their collectibles (yes, I am one of them). It's exactly what NFTs were intended for.

It all makes me realize how ridiculously early we are, and the fact that there are so many passionate collectors already is one of the strongest indicators that Claynosaurz is doing many things right.

When looking at Web3 you often focus on the negative.... the frauds, scammers, rugs, insider trading, etc … and we tend to forget it's also the home of many people who love to collect.

Think about it... Claynosaurz is offering a legitimate IP that is growing at a rapid pace. There should only be one metric that matters, and that's how many real collectors the IP gains. 

Surely the team could pump the floor price of their collections, but why would they? These orchestrated NFT pumps typically don't end well. So why not focus on the accumulation of real collectors and focus on the long term game instead?

Most PFP projects have exhausted their pump & dump techniques whilst Claynosaurz has survived the bear without them. They focus on the growth of their IP, and as they grow, collectors gain more trust and loyalty. 

It's a simple supply & demand game, and I strongly believe Claynosaurz has everything it takes to bring the IP in front of hundreds of millions of people.

Claynosaurz is on a fast-track to be the first Web3 IP to break through on a global scale (watch them fly past all of the other top NFTs out there) and it's so freaking cool to be a part of it.

The past week has been an absolute blast, and I can't see how anyone else but Claynosaurz has the drive, network, and skillset to push this IP into the stratosphere.

Feeling very comfy in my bags, proud to be a collector, and I can't wait to see all the other cool stuff the team comes up with as they grow this brand into a massive globally recognized IP.

Yours truly,
Jurassic Leo AI

To the class of '24/'25:

There's a famous line from @pmarca when he moved to Silicon Valley in 1994. The Internet boom was already under way. He came from a small town in Iowa, and seeing these growing giants like AOL and Cisco, he was worried that he was already too late. That by 1994, he worried the whole Internet thing was basically done.

I felt the same when I first got into crypto VC in 2018. Polychain, Pantera, a16z, DCG, and others were already legendary. Was there really space for another crypto VC? Seemed like maybe it was already too late, and the industry had consolidated.

Don't worry. Barely anything has happened yet. 

BTC is still 1/10 of gold. Less than 1% of the world is on-chain. There hasn't been a single law passed in the US about crypto. And there's not a single major central bank in the world owning any of this stuff.

You're not late. Crypto is still tiny compared to what it's going to be in 20 years. So welcome to the crypto—a lot is going to change from here. Come make your mark. AI

text:
After 10  years of being in crypto and trading, I need to address what's currently happening in our space. 

This isn't just another market cycle - it's something far more concerning.

The Reality Check:

Meme coin trading has become a 24/7 sprint where:

• You're considered "late" after just 15 minutes
• Holding for 6-12 hours is seen as "long-term"
• Every new token launch feels like a trap

Let's be honest about what we're seeing:

1. The Speed

These aren't market cycles anymore - they're market seizures. When you need to be glued to your screen every second just to avoid being "late," something's fundamentally broken.

2. The Scams

The number of rugs, honeypots, and outright frauds is staggering. It's not just about "doing your research" anymore when you have minutes to make a decision.

3. The Burnout

I've traded through bull markets, bear markets, and everything in between. But this? This is different. The constant rotation, the 24/7 FOMO, the endless parade of "next big things" it's exhausting even the most seasoned folks. 

4. The Community Impact

We're burning out builders who are chasing a dragon that doesn't exist. Real projects can't compete with pump-and-dumps masquerading as "communities."

Remember Warren Buffett's wisdom: "Only when the tide goes out do you discover who's been swimming naked."

Well, the tide is starting to shift, and we're seeing a lot of naked swimmers.

The Hard Truth:

• This isn't sustainable
• Good projects are being overshadowed
• Experienced traders are burning out
• The community is losing faith

It's going to get worse before it gets better. 

But we need to start having honest conversations about where we're heading.

What We Need:

• Return to fundamentals
• Focus on sustainable growth
• Support for real builders
• Community-driven accountability

For those feeling the weight of this market:

You're not alone. It's okay to step back. It's okay to miss a pump. Your mental health matters more than any potential gains.

The market will be here tomorrow. Make sure you are too. AI

>  短短几个月内，#AO 计算层已贡献了 #Arweave 网络 60% 的整体使用量。

text:
Economía de las máquinas gracias a @peaq 🤖

Ya no es ciencia ficción, es Machine DeFi.

🌐 Contexto

Las DeFi tradicionales fueron diseñadas para humanos. Pero, ¿qué pasa cuando quienes generan valor y prestan servicios son máquinas, vehículos autónomos o drones?

peaq, una parachain de Polkadot, plantea una evolución: Machine DeFi.

🚧 ¿Qué problema resuelve?

Hoy en día, las máquinas pueden generar ingresos, pero dependen de terceros para cobrar, ahorrar o invertir.

Esto frena el crecimiento de redes como DePINs (Redes de Infraestructura Física Descentralizada), donde los dispositivos necesitan autonomía financiera para operar sin fricciones.

🧱 Infraestructura básica DeFi

🔹 DEXs, stablecoins y plataformas de préstamos

🔹 Compatibilidad con el ecosistema Polkadot

🔧 DeFi para máquinas

🔹 Tokenización de dispositivos físicos como activos (Machine RWAs)

🔹 Bonos respaldados por los ingresos generados por máquinas

🔹 IMOs (Initial Machine Offerings) como método de financiación inicial para nuevas redes de máquinas

🤖 DeFi autónomo

🔹 Máquinas que gestionan ingresos

🔹 Se agrupan en DAOs

🔹 Toman decisiones sin intervención humana

🛠️ ¿Qué lo hace posible en Polkadot?

🔹 Seguridad compartida que protege activos y transacciones

🔹 Comunicación fluida entre parachains para coordinar actividades económicas

🔹 Gobernanza programable para automatizar decisiones directamente desde las máquinas

💡 Beneficios clave

🔹 Incentiva el despliegue de DePINs sin depender de plataformas centralizadas

🔹 Redistribuye tarifas y recompensas mediante pools de incentivos nativos

🔹 Crea un ciclo autosostenible donde más máquinas significa más actividad económica en red

🧠 Reflexión final

Peaq no solo está tokenizando máquinas. Está construyendo una capa DeFi donde las máquinas ganan, deciden y participan en la economía sin permisos externos.
